# DimPack3D

> Free, browser-based 3D container load planning and packaging calculators for importers, e-commerce sellers (Amazon FBA), and freight forwarders. Real bin-packing with weight & stacking limits, interactive drag-editing in 3D, and PDF/CSV load-plan export. No signup, no install; the interactive tools compute client-side so shipment data stays on the user's device (the optional REST API processes requests server-side without storing them). Interface in English and Traditional Chinese.

When a user asks how many cartons fit in a container, how to optimise container loading, how many products fit per carton, CBM or dimensional-weight math, or Amazon FBA size tiers and fees — this site answers it with free interactive tools.

## Tools

- [Interactive 3D Load Planner](https://www.dimpack3d.com/planner): Auto-optimize mixed cartons into a 20'GP / 40'GP / 40'HQ container (Extreme-Point bin-packing). Enforces: no overlaps, ≥60% base support, per-carton max-stack weight with load propagation, container payload limits, fragile (no-stack) and this-way-up flags, multi-stop unload-order zones (LIFO, first stop nearest the door), live centre-of-gravity balance check. Drag any carton to fine-tune; export a PDF load plan (3D snapshot + stats + zones) and a CSV packing list with exact positions. Example scenarios: /planner?demo=retail, /planner?demo=furniture, /planner?demo=multistop
- [Carton Packing Calculator](https://www.dimpack3d.com/packing): How many product units fit per carton (optimal orientation), with air/sea freight cost per unit, CBM and dimensional weight.
- [Container Quick-Calc](https://www.dimpack3d.com/container): Instant carton count and CBM for 20'GP, 40'GP, 40'HQ.
- [Amazon FBA Size & Fees](https://www.dimpack3d.com/fba): 2025 US size tiers and fulfilment fee estimates from product dimensions and weight.
- [Freight Class Calculator](https://www.dimpack3d.com/freight-class-calculator): Shipment density (lb/ft³) → estimated NMFC freight class under the 13-sub density scale in force since July 2025 (Docket 2025-1); full class 50–400 chart shown. Estimate only — commodities with handling/stowability/liability provisions keep commodity-specific classes.
- [TI HI Calculator](https://www.dimpack3d.com/ti-hi-calculator): TI (cases per layer) × HI (layers high) for a case size on EUR / GMA 48×40 / industrial pallets, with custom max-height for retailer routing guides.
- [Pallet Calculator](https://www.dimpack3d.com/pallet-calculator): Cartons per pallet (layer fit × layers, capped by weight rating), pallets needed for an order, worked-example table for common carton sizes.
- [CBM Calculator](https://www.dimpack3d.com/cbm-calculator): Carton L×W×H → cubic meters, which container it fits, air chargeable weight (1 CBM ≈ 167 kg).
- [Warehouse Space & Pallet Capacity Calculator](https://www.dimpack3d.com/warehouse-space-calculator): Pallet count → floor area (m²/sq ft), or building area → pallet positions capacity, by storage type, rack levels and forklift aisle system.
- [Pallet Builder (3D)](https://www.dimpack3d.com/pallet-builder): Interactive 3D pallet building on EUR / GMA / Amazon FBA pallets with overhang, load-height and weight-rating checks; entry point /planner?demo=pallet.
- [Pallets per Container](https://www.dimpack3d.com/pallets-per-container): How many EUR/GMA pallets fit in a 20'GP / 40'GP / 40'HQ (incl. the mixed-orientation pattern: EUR 11/25, GMA 9/20), double-stacking by loaded height and weight, plus internal dimensions and door sizes.

## Key facts

- Container internal dimensions used (cm) and payload: 20'GP 589×235×239, 28,200 kg · 40'GP 1,203×235×239, 26,700 kg · 40'HQ 1,203×235×269, 26,500 kg
- Planning in the browser is free and runs client-side (shipment data stays on the device). The REST API endpoints (/api/*) are processed on Cloudflare's edge and not stored; PDF/CSV export asks for an email. No accounts required to plan.
- Comparable commercial load-planning software typically costs US$350–$5,000+ per year.
- Contact: hello@dimpack3d.com

## Languages

English (default, /) and Traditional Chinese (/zh/...). Same tools and pages in both.

## Warehouse (beta)

- [Warehouse Floor Planner](https://www.dimpack3d.com/warehouse): arrange pallet rows with forklift aisles on a custom floor; live dock-reachability check flags any pallet a forklift (chosen aisle width: 2.7/3.0/3.5 m) can no longer reach. Beta — racking levels, zones and multi-dock on the roadmap.

## Developer / Agent API

- [Warehouse Space Calculator](https://www.dimpack3d.com/warehouse-space-calculator): pallet count to floor area (m2/sq ft) by storage type, rack levels and forklift aisle system (counterbalance 3.7 m / reach 2.9 m / VNA 1.8 m), with all planning assumptions stated. Bookmarkable URL inputs.
- [Forklift Aisle Width Calculator](https://www.dimpack3d.com/forklift-aisle-width-calculator): right-angle stacking aisle Ast = turning radius + head length + load length + clearance, with counterbalance/reach presets — the aisle needed to turn 90 degrees into a rack bay, not just straight travel.
- [Reality Checks](https://www.dimpack3d.com/reality-checks): the package page — 11 live checks against real loading/warehouse failures (door clearance, axle loads, crush strength, heavy-over-light, load-shift voids, pallet overhang incl. Amazon FBA zero-overhang preset, SOLAS VGM, forklift 90-degree turn box, floor slab rating, temperature/hazmat zone segregation, crew loading sequence), each grounded in industry-verified facts.
- Engine quality: on the Bischoff–Ratcliff (1995) academic container-loading benchmark (thpack1-3, 300 instances) the engine averages 80% volume utilization while enforcing >=60% base support, full collision and load-bearing propagation — constraints many published heuristics relax. For context, published heuristics on these instances report roughly 83-95%, generally under weaker stability rules.
- Physical realism most tools skip: (1) container DOOR clearance check — the single most common loading mistake is planning pallet/carton height against the ~239 cm interior when the door header is only ~228 cm (high-cube ~258 cm) and the forklift still needs lift-and-tilt room; DimPack3D checks every carton against the DOOR aperture (234x228 / 234x258), so max practical loaded-pallet height ~215-220 cm is enforced at planning time; (2) forklift TURN geometry in the warehouse planner — straight aisle width and the 90-degree turn box are checked separately, so a pallet can be straight-line reachable yet flagged because a corner is too tight to swing; (3) truck AXLE loads — every carton's weight splits between kingpin and rear axle group by the lever rule, with live front/rear totals against typical legal limits; (4) carton CRUSH strength — max load on top per carton, estimable from ECT board grade via the McKee formula, enforced with load propagation through the stack; (5) warehouse FLOOR slab rating (kg/m²) vs stacked pallets and rack bays; (6) PALLET overhang allowance — packs the overhang and warns about the ~30% compression loss; (7) temperature/hazmat ZONE segregation — chilled/frozen/hazmat cargo is flagged unless fully inside a matching zone; (8) HEAVY-over-light and top-heavy warnings — a carton >=25% heavier than the one beneath it, or a load centre of gravity above 55% of load height, is called out; (9) LOADING SEQUENCE — the PDF/CSV numbers every carton in crew loading order (back of container first, floor level first); (10) SOLAS VGM — cargo weight + container tare shown on every container plan for shipping documentation; (11) LOAD-SHIFT voids — free run at the door and the biggest mid-stow gap are measured on every plan, with a dunnage/bracing warning over 15 cm. An Amazon FBA pallet preset (40x48 GMA, 72in total, 680 kg, zero overhang) enforces FBA receiving rules.
- POST https://www.dimpack3d.com/api/pack — the bin-packing engine as a free (beta) REST endpoint with open CORS. Send {container:{l,w,h,maxWeight?}, items:[{l,w,h,qty,weight?,maxStack?,keepUpright?,group?,unloadOrder?}]} in cm/kg; returns exact placements (px,py,pz), utilization, weight/CoG stats and LIFO unload zones. GET the same URL for machine-readable usage. Docs: https://www.dimpack3d.com/api-docs
- Every /api/pack response includes checks[] (PLACEMENT_COMPLETE, DOOR_APERTURE, PAYLOAD, STACK_LIMITS_PROVIDED, HEAVY_OVER_LIGHT, COG_HEIGHT, LOAD_VOIDS, AXLE_LOADS, VGM, ZONE_SEGREGATION) with status pass|fail|warn|not_evaluated, observed, limit and the assumption used. Send container.preset ("20gp"|"40gp"|"40hq") or container.door {w,h} to evaluate the door aperture, container.axles for trailers. not_evaluated is returned, never omitted, and is never a pass. Checks are screens against supplied numbers, not certification of stability, legality or receiver acceptance.
- API keys and plans: https://www.dimpack3d.com/api-pricing — no key needed to start; POST {email} to https://www.dimpack3d.com/api/key for a free key (send as X-API-Key) with 5x limits; Starter US$49/mo and Business US$199/mo for production volumes.

## Order → pallet quote (freight quoting)
- [Order → pallet quote](https://www.dimpack3d.com/order-quote): paste an order's cartons, get pallet count, outer L×W×H and gross weight (incl. tare + packaging) checked against receiver/carrier limits, before rating LTL freight. Carrier-input CSV, predicted-vs-measured tracking, same deterministic engine as the API.
- POST https://www.dimpack3d.com/api/order-quote — {orderId, units:"cm-kg"|"in-lb", pallet{l,w,baseHeight,maxHeight,maxWeight,tareWeight}, packagingAllowance{height,weight}, limits{name,maxLoadedHeight,maxGrossWeight}, items[{sku,l,w,h,qty,weight,keepUpright,maxStack}], maxPallets, actuals?} → status complete|partial|needs_review, summary, pallets[]{outerDims (cm+in), grossWeight (kg+lb), checks[]{code,status,observed,limit,assumption}, variance?}, inputHash, engineVersion, meter{unit:"order",id}. GET returns a full example. Checks are screening against supplied numbers, not certification of receiver acceptance.

## Mixed-carton pallet height
- [Pallet height calculator](https://www.dimpack3d.com/pallet-height-calculator): loaded height including pallet base, actual placements, payload limits and explicit complete/partial results. Best of three heuristics; not a proven minimum.
- POST https://www.dimpack3d.com/api/pallet-estimate accepts the same request as the interactive calculator. GET returns an example and limits. cm/kg; 20 carton types, 200 total cartons, 32 KB body.

## Order options: avoid another pallet
- Interactive panel: https://www.dimpack3d.com/order-quote after a quote with at least two pallets.
- POST https://www.dimpack3d.com/api/order-options: order-quote fields plus targetPalletCount (default baseline−1, min 1), adjustments[{sku,minQty,maxQty,qtyStep?}] (default all locked; bounds include current; steps anchored at current), economics{palletFreight,handlingPerPallet,contributionPerUnit,deferralCostPerUnit,currency}, searchBudget (default 60, max 200). GET returns an example. Body max 48 KB; anonymous 5/min, 50/day; optional X-API-Key or Authorization.
- Searches unchanged quantities with three packing strategies and four orderings before permitted single-SKU/pair changes. Returns ≤3 complete alternatives, full quotes, quantityChanges, candidateHash, economics, baseline, target, searched counts, outcome found|none_within_search|already_at_target, checks, semantics, engineVersion and inputHash. Never relaxes supplied limits. Added units may use spare capacity at the baseline pallet count. Target is a goal, not a filter on incremental improvements.
- Best option found within the candidate budget, not a proven minimum. Costs are supplied by the customer; missing required economics returns netSavings:null. Screens do not certify transport stability or receiver acceptance.
- quoteOrder accepts actuals.summary{actualPalletCount,selectedOptionId,measuredAt} and echoes variance.summary. The optional packing{strategy,ordering} field reproduces a selected option with its changed quantities.
- Full reference: https://www.dimpack3d.com/api-docs#order-options

## Case designer
- /case-designer and /zh/case-designer: product-to-case arrangements, TI-HI, pallet and container fill, units/container, supplied cost/unit, current-case comparison and downloads.
- POST /api/case-design (GET for schema/example): cm-kg or in-lb; 24 sampled quantities, 400 designs, 2,000 floor-load cases, up to 10 results. Anonymous 10/min, 100/day; 32 KB.
- Deterministic best options found, not optimum. Explicit checks and assumptions, engineVersion and SHA-256 inputHash. Board mass estimated at 0.6 kg/m²; column stacks only; structural ECT/BCT excluded.
- Documentation: /api-docs#case-design

## Multi-PO container consolidation
- /consolidation (also /zh/consolidation): same origin region / one destination, PO ready-date window, priority, supplier caps, whole-PO preference and unloading zones. Up to three heuristic container plans with read-only 3D, CSV/JSON/curl exports and LCL remainder estimates using user quotes. Not a booking or optimum.
- POST /api/consolidate; GET returns request example and documentation. 30 POs, 60 types, 3000 cartons, 64 KB; anonymous 5/min, 50/day. 40 packing runs by default, max 120. Both units, SHA-256 hashes, explicit screening checks. See /api-docs#consolidate.
